notes.dreadKnight: Dread Knight is never optimal to gild. Sources list the start level as either 1,000 or 1,500; either is fine.
notes.bareExponent: From here on gold is written as the bare exponent, the number after the “e”.
notes.rangersAndBeasts: Most rangers and beasts become optimal at level 1,000.
notes.thePattern: The pattern by now: hire to 1,000, gild, level to 1,500, move on.
notes.bomberMaxUpgrade: At Chiron 1,100, buy Bomber Max to level 100 for his +50% gold found upgrade.
notes.gogUpgrade: At Moloch 1,100, buy Gog to level 100 for his +50% all-hero DPS upgrade.
notes.followWepwawet: From here, gilding follows Wepwawet upgrades.
notes.bettyClicker: Needs the Wepwawet upgrade at level 1,500, which boosts Betty heavily.
notes.kingMidas: Needs the Wepwawet upgrade at level 2,000. The wiki lists the end level as 13,575.
notes.wepAndGog: Wep and Gog now trade off every ~500 levels as each gains a new 10x.
notes.stayOnWep: Gog gets no more 10x multipliers after level 8,000, so stay on Wep from here.
notes.hireTsuchi: Hiring Tsuchi at level 1 costs less than 25 more levels of Wepwawet, and is instantly better.
notes.lastSoulsEstimate: Last row with a meaningful Ancient Souls estimate. Past here, use a progression calculator.
notes.eitherGuardian: Either Guardian works here. Cadu gets the first upgrade, which boosts Ceus.
notes.ceusBoostsCadu: At 116,000 Ceus boosts Cadu. The alternating pattern continues from here.
notes.lastCeusUpgrade: The last Ceus upgrade unlocks here. After this, stay on Cadu until The Maw.
notes.theMaw: The Maw at level 1 deals roughly 1e6750x the damage of Cadu at 680,625, for the same price.
notes.yachiyl: Yachiyl does less damage than The Maw until its first upgrade at 157,500, which is why you start it there. Reaching this row means you have beaten 1.0e10.
notes.roseLevel: Because of 1.0e11 hero scaling, Rose is not immediately better than Yachiyl. She needs level 9,700.
notes.noUpgradesFirst: Run through each scout with no upgrades first.
notes.firstUpgrades: Now start collecting each scout first upgrade. This rotating pattern continues to the end.
notes.skipDorothy1: Skip Dorothy 1: it costs more but deals less damage than Rose 2.
notes.skipDorothy2: Skip Dorothy 2, same reason as before.
notes.dorothy3: Dorothy 3 is worth taking, unlike 1 and 2.
notes.skipDorothy4: Skip Dorothy 4, same reason as before.

lookup.label: Your gold
lookup.hint: Paste the whole figure or just the exponent. Only the order of magnitude matters.
lookup.invalid: That does not look like a gold amount. Try something like <mono>1.4e442</mono> or <mono>442</mono>.
lookup.belowChart: <mono>{gold}</mono> is below the first chart entry at <mono>{first}</mono>. The chart starts after your first transcension. Until then, put whatever gilds you have on one of the Power 5 and level that hero.
lookup.defaultNote: Move every gild you own onto {hero} and level from {from} to {to}.
lookup.nextUp: Next up: <hero>{hero}</hero> at <gold>{gold}</gold>, {count, plural, one {{distance} order} other {{distance} orders}} of magnitude away.
lookup.lastRow: This is the last row of the chart. Nothing further is tabulated.
